'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: CHEERS TO UNCLE WIGGILY.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' steal the blind
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
